pr_body:
This PR updates the BAP API such that it is possible to use non-HCI data path with BAP. 

Fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/45613

depends on https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/46168

issue_context.title: LE Audio: Setting ISO chan path and CC from BAP
issue_context.body:
**Is your enhancement proposal related to a problem? Please describe.**
The BAP Codec Configuration is never applied to the data path when calling `hci_le_setup_iso_data_path`, and also only supports HCI data path. 

**Describe the solution you'd like**
The data path needs to be configurable from the BAP API, as well as automatically settings the CC from the `bt_codec` used in BAP

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
N/A

**Additional context**
N/A

review_comments: I believe this is _part_ of the presentation delay.

Hmm, maybe it's related. But it's described as:
```c
When Data_Path_Direction is set to 0x00 (input), the Controller_Delay param-
eter specifies the delay at the data source from the reference time of an SDU to
the CIG reference point (see [Vol 6] Part B, Section 4.5.14.1) or BIG anchor
point (see [Vol 6] Part B, Section 4.4.6.4). When Data_Path_Direction is set to
0x01 (output), Controller_Delay specifies the delay from the
SDU_Synchronization_Reference to the point in time at which the Controller
begins to transfer the corresponding data to the data path interface. The Host
should use the HCI_Read_Local_Supported_Controller_Delay command to
obtain a suitable value for Controller_Delay.
```

So it is a delay between the local controller and the host, and not the delay between the two hosts.

I think that fits well with being a part of the presentation delay.

From BAP 7.1.1: "For reception of a frame of audio data by a Unicast Server in the Audio Sink role or by a Broadcast Sink, the Presentation_Delay parameter value is the time period between the SDU Synchronization Reference and the start of presentation of that frame of audio data"
And from BAP 7.1: "The value of the Presentation_Delay parameter includes any implementation-specific delays in the Unicast Server and/or Broadcast Sink, such as processing time for internal transports, codec processing, ADC/DAC delays, application-specific audio processing, etc."

The delay above gives the time from the SDU reference point until data are transferred to the host.  The host will then spend some time decoding, and the remaining part of the presentation delay, the host/application must buffer the data.

For incoming data it can perhaps be used, although it won't be able to take any processing at the host or application layer into account (including decoding). 

So We cannot just set this to the presentation delay if we are doing ISO over HCI.

I think that is just my point.
But the comment seems to indicate that we might do that (set it to presentation delay).
It's a comment, with a question mark, though.
